package_kind: sanitized derivative, not a byte-identical original freeze
sanitization_scope: absolute paths / user directory identifiers only; unexpected identifiers block the build
hash_semantics: source_sha256 refers to private original bytes; public_sha256 verifies distributed bytes. Hash references inside historical manifests remain original and must not be used as derivative-file hashes.
omitted: Per-batch JSONL, binary plots/assets, checkpoints, datasets, scripts and non-P2-07 stage archives are not distributed. This is a selected evidence package, not full raw evidence or a runnable training repository.
